modeling_decisions: Retain isolated asymmetrical hill and low plain from concept; round the overly planar top to unequal continuous convex crest, remove loose huge angular talus and square plaque. Integral irregular plain perimeter with low thickness, sparse shallow weathering grooves on hill. Not batch78 exfoliation dome: no giant shell, no concentric sheets; isolation and abrupt foot diagnostic. Public view of Uluru used only broad isolation, no exact form or restricted detail.
